narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives were the same. In month {fork_month} your mother asked, and you chose {real_choice}, while the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month {first_bar_apart} was the first score to part, the cushion under each of you. The ghost's money sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month} the ghost had {net_worth_gap}.
